# montecarlo_hosting_network (Data Source)

The public IP addresses Monte Carlo connects from, for allowlisting it in your firewalls and access policies.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `instance_region` (String) The region of your Monte Carlo instance to read. `primary`, the default, is the region serving your instance, which is the recovery region during a failover. `secondary` is the disaster recovery region, and only an instance with disaster recovery has one. With disaster recovery, read both and allow both, so access keeps working after a failover. During a failover both read the recovery region, so applying your policies then drops the original primary region until you apply them again after failing back.

### Read-Only

- `collection_ip_addresses` (List of String) Addresses Monte Carlo collects from, such as when it reaches your warehouse, collection agent or data store over the internet.
- `data_platform_ip_addresses` (List of String) Addresses Monte Carlo's data processing services connect from.
- `saas_ip_addresses` (List of String) Addresses the rest of the Monte Carlo platform connects from.
- `webhook_ip_addresses` (List of String) Addresses Monte Carlo sends webhook notifications from.
